failure: TornadoOutOfMemoryException while allocating a 24.9 MiB DeltaNet checkpoint bank (cuMemAlloc status=2)
resolution: The default weight cache now reserves half of device global memory minus 4 GiB, capped at 16 GiB; dense projections retain up to 8 GiB and MoE uses the remainder. The same three-call/reset workload then passed.
